title: Second Opinion
subtitle: Review of reports, lab results and clinical cases: what to double-check, what is missing from the data, what must not be missed. The doctor writes and signs the conclusion.
newCasePlaceholder: New case: e.g. chest CT, focal lesion
labelHint: “Patient K.” or a chart number. The name is not needed: the review does not depend on it.
newCaseNote: Materials, the question and clinical data are added inside. The patient's name is not needed anywhere: the review does not depend on it.
noCases: No cases yet — create the first one.
deleteBody: The case “{{title}}” and everything in it — materials, the review, your conclusion — will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
contextPlaceholder: Age, complaints, course, what has already been ruled out.
savedOnBlur: Will be saved when you leave the field
materialsClosed: The case is closed — materials cannot be changed.
protocolNote: These are the points the material is checked against. Shown before sending: a hidden protocol would mean trusting blindly.
analysisProgress: {{done}} of {{total}} done. Takes minutes — you can close the page.
analysisWillSend: Materials will be sent to an external model — we will ask for confirmation before the first run.
analysisByMaterials: Directions are chosen from the materials present.
analysisStalled: The review is taking longer than usual to respond. It most likely broke off — reload the page: unfinished jobs will be marked failed and can be restarted.
criticalNotice: There are critical findings ({{count}}) — they are first in the list.
conclusionPlaceholder: What you concluded and what was prescribed.
conclusionByDoctor: The conclusion is written by the doctor
confirmLead: Materials will be sent to an external model for processing. Confirm two conditions — we ask once per case.
gateDeidentifiedWhy: No names, dates of birth, document numbers or phone numbers. Check the form header separately — that is where a name most often remains.
gateConsent: Consent to processing by an external model.
gateConsentWhy: The time of confirmation is recorded — it is part of the answer to why the data left your systems.
addWhat: Paste the report text or describe the case. You can attach a photo of a form — we will read it.
attachHint: Photo of a form or a PDF. The file is not stored — only the text reaches the case.
readImageHint: CT, MRI, ultrasound, echocardiography, X-ray, ECG, EEG, ABR, endoscopy. The model looks at the image itself and describes what is visible. The file is not stored.
imageReadNote: This describes what is visible, not a report. No findings on a single image does not mean the patient has none.
checkNumbers: Check the numbers and units — the calculations use them.
identityVisible: Patient identifiers are visible — remove them from the text.
identityInTags: Patient identifiers are inside the file (DICOM tags): {{list}}. They are not visible on the image and cannot be removed from the text — upload a de-identified export. Only the slice is sent to the model; tag values are not.
dicomSampled: {{shown}} of {{total}} slices were read — an even sample across the series. A finding between the shown slices will not be noticed.
addTextOrFile: Add text or attach a document
fillOneAnalyte: Fill in at least one test with a value
panelNote: Copy the reference range from the form — laboratories differ. Without it there is nothing to compare against. A dot ● marks tests with an act-now threshold; custom tests are reviewed, but without thresholds.
verdictQuestion: Do you agree with this finding? The answer is not for reporting — it shows where the review goes wrong.
correctionPlaceholder: Where the finding is wrong or incomplete. Write it as you would to a colleague — the module editor will read it, not the patient.
verdictSaved: Recorded. You can change the verdict at any time.
dataGaps: What is missing from the description
dataGapsHint: These are not findings about the patient — they are what to add so the review can go further.
answerHint: Below is the point-by-point review: what to confirm, what to rule out, what is missing.
